name: context-outline.nvim
summary: A Neovim port of the Context Outline VS Code extension. It finds a project's .context-outline/root.json, shows it as a foldable tree in a side panel, and jumps to (and highlights) the code behind each step. It can also copy an item's title as context for an AI tool, and copy prompts that ask an AI tool to build or update the map.
basedOn: not a git repository (no branch or commit yet)
